title: Stanford Center on Longevity Design Challenge 2026-2027
description: Design robotics solutions that support longer, healthier lives. Open to teams of 1-5 university students worldwide.
descriptionDetailed: The 14th Longevity Design Challenge asks student teams to design human-centered robotics that support longer lives and strengthen communities. Winners receive up to $10,000 in cash prizes, and finalists get $1,000 plus expert mentorship and a pitch at Stanford. Free to enter, open to any discipline.

prize.description: 1st place $10,000, 2nd place $5,000, 3rd place $2,000. Finalist teams each receive $1,000 plus mentorship from industry experts and researchers.

audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to teams of 1-5 students enrolled during the 2026-2027 academic year at any accredited university or college globally. Each team needs at least one full-time student, and only students may present in the finals.
